title: Iranians Rally at Persepolis to Protest Rubio Remarks, Defend Ancient Civilization
text:
Iranians Rally at Persepolis to Protest Rubio Remarks, Defend Ancient Civilization"

"🔆🔅PERSEPOLIS, Iran, Oct. 14 — A public gathering titled “Devotees of Iranian Civilization” was held at Persepolis, a UNESCO World Heritage site near Marvdasht in Fars Province, southern Iran, on Wednesday, 14 October 2026, to protest against remarks by U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and to express support for Iran’s ancient heritage and rich civilization, Iranian state media reported. People from various segments of society attended the event."

"The gathering followed remarks by Rubio in Athens, in which he claimed that the armies of Xerxes I burned temples and sanctuaries in Athens in 480 BC. Iranian officials and citizens rejected the claim as a distortion of history, the report said."

"State media said the event aimed to demonstrate the grandeur of Iran’s civilization, national identity and public resistance to what it described as baseless statements by foreign politicians.
